# Estimation Algorithms for the Latent Block Model

## 1. Function

### Simulation LBM

```{r}
#Simulate LBM 
simulate_LBM <- function(n, m, K, L, pi, rho, gamma){
  Z <- sample(1:K, n, replace = TRUE, prob = pi)
  W <- sample(1:L, m, replace = TRUE, prob = rho)
  Y <- matrix(0, n, m)
  for (i in 1:n) {
    for (j in 1:m) {
      prob <- gamma[Z[i], W[j]]
      Y[i,j] <- rbinom(1, 1, prob) # acording to binomial law
    }
  }
  list(Y = Y, Z = Z, W = W)
}
```

### Gibbs Sampler

```{r}
# Gibbs sampler
gibbs_LBM <- function(Y, K, L, n_iter = 1000, a = 1, b = 1, alpha = rep(1,K), beta = rep(1,L)) {
  n <- nrow(Y)
  m <- ncol(Y)
  
  # Random init
  Z <- sample(1:K, n, replace = TRUE)
  W <- sample(1:L, m, replace = TRUE)
  Lambda <- matrix(runif(K*L, 0.3, 0.7), nrow = K)
  pi <- rep(1/K, K)
  rho <- rep(1/L, L)
  
  # Stockage des tirages
  Z_store <- matrix(0, n_iter, n)
  W_store <- matrix(0, n_iter, m)
  Lambda_store <- array(0, dim = c(n_iter, K, L))
  
  for (iter in 1:n_iter) {
    
    ## --- 1. Mettre à jour Z ---
    for (i in 1:n) {
      probs <- rep(0, K)
      for (q in 1:K) {
        logp <- log(pi[q])
        for (j in 1:m) {
          l <- W[j]
          yij <- Y[i,j]
          logp <- logp + yij * log(Lambda[q,l]) + (1-yij) * log(1-Lambda[q,l])
        }
        probs[q] <- exp(logp)
      }
      probs <- probs / sum(probs)
      Z[i] <- sample(1:K, 1, prob = probs)
    }
    
    ## --- 2. Mettre à jour W ---
    for (j in 1:m) {
      probs <- rep(0, L)
      for (l in 1:L) {
        logp <- log(rho[l])
        for (i in 1:n) {
          q <- Z[i]
          yij <- Y[i,j]
          logp <- logp + yij * log(Lambda[q,l]) + (1-yij) * log(1-Lambda[q,l])
        }
        probs[l] <- exp(logp)
      }
      probs <- probs / sum(probs)
      W[j] <- sample(1:L, 1, prob = probs)
    }
    
    ## --- 3. Mettre à jour Lambda ---
    for (q in 1:K) {
      for (l in 1:L) {
        y_q_l <- Y[Z == q, , drop = FALSE][ ,W == l, drop = FALSE]
        sum_y <- sum(y_q_l)
        n_links <- length(y_q_l)
        Lambda[q,l] <- rbeta(1, a + sum_y, b + n_links - sum_y)
      }
    }
    
    ## --- 4. Mettre à jour pi et rho ---
    pi <- as.numeric(gtools::rdirichlet(1, alpha + tabulate(Z, nbins = K)))
    rho <- as.numeric(gtools::rdirichlet(1, beta + tabulate(W, nbins = L)))
    
    ## --- Stocker les tirages ---
    Z_store[iter,] <- Z
    W_store[iter,] <- W
    Lambda_store[iter,,] <- Lambda
    
    if (iter %% 100 == 0) cat("Itération", iter, "terminée\n")
  }
  
  list(Z = Z_store, W = W_store, Lambda = Lambda_store)
}
```

### Generate Param LBM

```{r}
# Init param LBM (lambda, pi, rho)
initialize_LBM_params <- function(K, 
                                   L, 
                                   pi_init = NULL, 
                                   rho_init = NULL, 
                                   Lambda_init = NULL,
                                   lambda_min = 0.01,
                                   lambda_max = 0.99,
                                   dirichlet_alpha = 1,
                                   seed = NULL) {
  
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  
  # Validation des entrées
  stopifnot(K >= 1, L >= 1)
  stopifnot(lambda_min >= 0, lambda_max <= 1, lambda_min < lambda_max)
  stopifnot(dirichlet_alpha > 0)
  
  # ---- Initialisation de pi (proportions des clusters lignes) ----
  if (is.null(pi_init)) {
    # Utiliser une distribution de Dirichlet
    # Si alpha = 1 : uniforme, alpha < 1 : sparse, alpha > 1 : équilibré
    pi <- rdirichlet(1, rep(dirichlet_alpha, K))
    pi <- as.numeric(pi)
  } else {
    stopifnot(length(pi_init) == K, all(pi_init > 0), abs(sum(pi_init) - 1) < 1e-6)
    pi <- pi_init
  }
  
  # ---- Initialisation de rho (proportions des clusters colonnes) ----
  if (is.null(rho_init)) {
    rho <- rdirichlet(1, rep(dirichlet_alpha, L))
    rho <- as.numeric(rho)
  } else {
    stopifnot(length(rho_init) == L, all(rho_init > 0), abs(sum(rho_init) - 1) < 1e-6)
    rho <- rho_init
  }
  
  # ---- Initialisation de Lambda (matrice de connectivité K x L) ----
  if (is.null(Lambda_init)) {
    # Générer des probabilités uniformes entre lambda_min et lambda_max
    Lambda <- matrix(runif(K * L, min = lambda_min, max = lambda_max), 
                     nrow = K, ncol = L)
  } else {
    stopifnot(is.matrix(Lambda_init), 
              nrow(Lambda_init) == K, 
              ncol(Lambda_init) == L,
              all(Lambda_init >= 0), 
              all(Lambda_init <= 1))
    Lambda <- Lambda_init
  }
  
  # Retourner les paramètres
  params <- list(
    K = K,
    L = L,
    pi = pi,
    rho = rho,
    Lambda = Lambda
  )
  
  return(params)
}
```

### Dirichlet Distribution

```{r}
# Dirichlet distribution
rdirichlet <- function(n, alpha) {
  k <- length(alpha)
  samples <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = k)
  
  for (i in 1:n) {
    # Générer des variables Gamma
    gamma_samples <- rgamma(k, shape = alpha, rate = 1)
    # Normaliser pour obtenir des probabilités
    samples[i, ] <- gamma_samples / sum(gamma_samples)
  }
  
  return(samples)
}
```

### Print param LBM

```{r}
print_LBM_params <- function(params) {
  cat("========================================\n")
  cat("Paramètres du Latent Block Model\n")
  cat("========================================\n\n")
  
  cat("Nombre de clusters lignes (K):", params$K, "\n")
  cat("Nombre de clusters colonnes (L):", params$L, "\n\n")
  
  cat("Proportions des clusters lignes (pi):\n")
  print(round(params$pi, 4))
  cat("Somme:", round(sum(params$pi), 6), "\n\n")
  
  cat("Proportions des clusters colonnes (rho):\n")
  print(round(params$rho, 4))
  cat("Somme:", round(sum(params$rho), 6), "\n\n")
  
  cat("Matrice de connectivité Lambda (K x L):\n")
  print(round(params$Lambda, 3))
  cat("\n")
  
  # Statistiques sur Lambda
  cat("Statistiques sur Lambda:\n")
  cat("  Min:", round(min(params$Lambda), 3), "\n")
  cat("  Max:", round(max(params$Lambda), 3), "\n")
  cat("  Moyenne:", round(mean(params$Lambda), 3), "\n")
  cat("  Médiane:", round(median(params$Lambda), 3), "\n")
  cat("========================================\n")
}
```

### Algorithme VEM

```{r}
VEM_LBM <- function(Y, K, L, max_iter = 200, tol = 1e-6, soft_init = 0.9) {
  n <- as.integer(nrow(Y))
  m <- as.integer(ncol(Y))
  K <- as.integer(K)
  L <- as.integer(L)

 
  set.seed(123)  # pour reproductibilité
  km_rows <- kmeans(Y, centers = K, nstart = 10)
  tau <- matrix(0, n, K)
  tau[cbind(1:n, km_rows$cluster)] <- 1  # assignations dures
  tau <- tau * soft_init + (1 - soft_init) / K  # adoucir un peu (soft_init ≈ 0.9)
  tau <- tau / rowSums(tau)

  # Pour les colonnes (xi)
  set.seed(456)
  km_cols <- kmeans(t(Y), centers = L, nstart = 10)
  xi <- matrix(0, m, L)
  xi[cbind(1:m, km_cols$cluster)] <- 1
  xi <- xi * soft_init + (1 - soft_init) / L
  xi <- xi / rowSums(xi)
  
  # Proportions et Lambda
  pi <- colMeans(tau)
  rho <- colMeans(xi)
  Lambda <- matrix(runif(K * L, 0.3, 0.7), K, L)
  
  # Stockage des tirages
  pi_store <- matrix(0, max_iter, K)
  rho_store <- matrix(0, max_iter, L)
  tau_store <- array(0, dim = c(max_iter, n, K))
  xi_store <- array(0, dim = c(max_iter, m, L))
  Lambda_store <- array(0, dim = c(max_iter, K, L))
  elbo_store <- rep(0,max_iter)
  elbo_prev <- -Inf
  
  n_iter <- max_iter
  for (iter in 1:max_iter) {
    ### --- M-step ---
    pi <- colMeans(tau)
    rho <- colMeans(xi)

    Lambda_new <- matrix(0, K, L)
    for (q in 1:K) {
      for (l in 1:L) {
        num <- sum(tau[,q] %*% t(xi[,l]) * Y)  # équivalent à double boucle
        den <- sum(tau[,q]) * sum(xi[,l])      # somme pondérée
        Lambda_new[q,l] <- ifelse(den > 0, num/den, 0.01)
      }
    }
    Lambda <- pmin(pmax(Lambda_new, 1e-6), 1-1e-6) # éviter 0 ou 1 exacts

    ### --- V-step : mise à jour tau ---
    log_tau <- matrix(0, n, K)
    for (i in 1:n) {
      for (q in 1:K) {
        sum_prob <- 0
        for (j in 1:m) {
          for (l in 1:L) {
            y_ij <- Y[i,j]
            sum_prob <- sum_prob + xi[j,l] * (y_ij * log(Lambda[q,l]) + 
                                                 (1 - y_ij) * log(1 - Lambda[q,l]))
          }
        }
        log_tau[i,q] <- log(pi[q]) + sum_prob
      }
    }
    tau <- exp(log_tau)
    tau <- tau / rowSums(tau)

    ### --- V-step : mise à jour xi ---
    log_xi <- matrix(0, m, L)
    for (j in 1:m) {
      for (l in 1:L) {
        sum_prob <- 0
        for (i in 1:n) {
          for (q in 1:K) {
            y_ij <- Y[i,j]
            sum_prob <- sum_prob + tau[i,q] * (y_ij * log(Lambda[q,l]) + 
                                               (1 - y_ij) * log(1 - Lambda[q,l]))
          }
        }
        log_xi[j,l] <- log(rho[l]) + sum_prob
      }
    }
    xi <- exp(log_xi)
    xi <- xi / rowSums(xi)

    ### --- Critère de convergence (ELBO approx) ---
    elbo <- sum(log(rowSums(exp(log_tau)))) + sum(log(rowSums(exp(log_xi))))
    elbo_store[iter] <- elbo
    if (abs(elbo - elbo_prev) < tol){
      n_iter <- iter-1
      break
    }
    elbo_prev <- elbo
    
    ## --- Stocker les tirages ---
    pi_store[iter,] <- pi
    rho_store[iter,] <- rho
    Lambda_store[iter,,] <- Lambda
    tau_store[iter,,] <- tau
    xi_store[iter,,] <- xi
    if (iter %% 20 == 0) cat("Itération", iter, "terminée\n")
  }

  list(tau = tau_store, xi = xi_store, pi = pi_store, rho = rho_store, Lambda = Lambda_store, elbo = elbo_store, n_iter=n_iter)
}
```

### Comparison MCMC VEM

```{r}
compare_MCMC_VEM <- function(params, N, M, n_iter_mcmc = 200, n_iter_vem = 200) {
  
  # Stocker tous les résultats
  all_results <- list()
  result_index <- 1
  
  total_combinations <- length(N) * length(M)
  current_combination <- 0
  
  for (n in N) {
    for (m in M) {
      current_combination <- current_combination + 1
      size_label <- paste0(n, "×", m)
      
      cat("\n========================================\n")
      cat("Progress:", current_combination, "/", total_combinations, "\n")
      cat("Taille:", size_label, "\n")
      cat("========================================\n")
      
      # Simuler les données
      sim <- simulate_LBM(n, m, params$K, params$L, 
                          params$pi, params$rho, params$Lambda)
      
      # --- MCMC (Gibbs sampling) ---
      cat("  Running MCMC (Gibbs)...\n")
      res_MCMC <- gibbs_LBM(sim$Y, params$K, params$L, n_iter = n_iter_mcmc)
      
      # Calculer ARI à chaque itération
      ari_mcmc_rows <- sapply(1:nrow(res_MCMC$Z), function(iter) {
        adjustedRandIndex(sim$Z, res_MCMC$Z[iter, ])
      })
      
      ari_mcmc_cols <- sapply(1:nrow(res_MCMC$W), function(iter) {
        adjustedRandIndex(sim$W, res_MCMC$W[iter, ])
      })
      
      df_mcmc <- data.frame(
        iteration = 1:length(ari_mcmc_rows),
        ARI_rows = ari_mcmc_rows,
        ARI_cols = ari_mcmc_cols,
        method = "MCMC",
        size = size_label,
        n = n,
        m = m
      )
      
      # --- VEM ---
      cat("  Running VEM...\n")
      res_VEM <- VEM_LBM(sim$Y, params$K, params$L, max_iter = n_iter_vem)
      
      # Calculer ARI à chaque itération
      ari_vem_rows <- sapply(1:res_VEM$n_iter, function(iter) {
        adjustedRandIndex(sim$Z, apply(res_VEM$tau[iter,,], 1, which.max))
      })
      
      ari_vem_cols <- sapply(1:res_VEM$n_iter, function(iter) {
        adjustedRandIndex(sim$W, apply(res_VEM$xi[iter,,], 1, which.max))
      })
      
      df_vem <- data.frame(
        iteration = 1:length(ari_vem_rows),
        ARI_rows = ari_vem_rows,
        ARI_cols = ari_vem_cols,
        method = "VEM",
        size = size_label,
        n = n,
        m = m
      )
      
      # Stocker
      all_results[[result_index]] <- rbind(df_mcmc, df_vem)
      result_index <- result_index + 1
      
      cat("  ARI final MCMC (rows):", round(tail(ari_mcmc_rows, 1), 3), "\n")
      cat("  ARI final VEM  (rows):", round(tail(ari_vem_rows, 1), 3), "\n")
      cat("  ARI final MCMC (cols):", round(tail(ari_mcmc_cols, 1), 3), "\n")
      cat("  ARI final VEM  (cols):", round(tail(ari_vem_cols, 1), 3), "\n")
    }
  }
  
  # Combiner tous les résultats
  results_df <- do.call(rbind, all_results)
  
  return(results_df)
}

```

### Plot comparison curves

```{r}
plot_all_curves_nm <- function(results, n, m) {
  
  # Créer la légende combinée
  results$legend_label <- paste0(results$method, " - K=", results$K, ", L=", results$L)
  results_MCMC <- dplyr::filter(results, method == "MCMC")
  results_VEM  <- dplyr::filter(results, method == "VEM")
  
  size_label <- paste0("n = ", n, ", m = ", m)
  
  # --- MCMC - Rows ---
  p_rows_MCMC <- ggplot(results_MCMC, aes(x = iteration, y = ARI_rows, 
                                          color = legend_label, group = legend_label)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
    labs(title = paste0("ARI MCMC - Rows Clustering (", size_label, ")"),
         x = "Iteration",
         y = "ARI",
         color = "Method - (K, L)") +

    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", alpha = 0.5) +

         x = "Iteration",

      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
    )
  
  # --- VEM - Columns ---
  p_cols_VEM <- ggplot(results_VEM, aes(x = iteration, y = ARI_cols,

    geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
    labs(title = paste0("ARI VEM - Columns Clustering (", size_label, ")"),
         x = "Iteration",
         y = "ARI",
         color = "Method - (K, L)") +
    ylim(-0.5, 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", alpha = 0.5) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
    )
  
  # Retourner les 4 graphes
  return(list(
    p_rows_MCMC = p_rows_MCMC,
    p_cols_MCMC = p_cols_MCMC,
    p_rows_VEM  = p_rows_VEM,
    p_cols_VEM  = p_cols_VEM
  ))
}
```

### Algorithme EM

```{r}

loglik_complete <- function(Y, Z, W, pi, rho, Lambda) {
  n <- nrow(Y); m <- ncol(Y)
  ll <- sum(log(pi[Z])) + sum(log(rho[W]))
  for (i in 1:n) {
    for (j in 1:m) {
      p <- Lambda[Z[i], W[j]]
      ll <- ll + ifelse(Y[i,j]==1, log(p), log(1-p))
    }
  }
  ll
}

# Enumerate all partitions (brute force!)
all_partitions <- function(n, K) {
  expand.grid(rep(list(1:K), n))
}

EM_LBM <- function(Y, K, L, max_iter=50, tol=1e-6) {
  n <- nrow(Y); m <- ncol(Y)
  
  # init params
  pi <- rep(1/K, K)
  rho <- rep(1/L, L)
  Lambda <- matrix(runif(K*L, 0.3, 0.7), K, L)
  
  # Precompute all partitions
  allZ <- as.matrix(all_partitions(n, K))
  allW <- as.matrix(all_partitions(m, L))
  
  loglik_trace <- c()
  
  for (iter in 1:max_iter) {
    # ---- E-step: compute posterior weights over (Z,W)
    weights <- c()
    for (a in 1:nrow(allZ)) {
      for (b in 1:nrow(allW)) {
        ll <- loglik_complete(Y, allZ[a,], allW[b,], pi, rho, Lambda)
        weights <- c(weights, ll)
      }
    }
    # normalize
    logliks <- weights
    log_norm <- logsumexp(logliks)
    probs <- exp(logliks - log_norm)
    
    # ---- M-step: expected counts
    pi_new <- rep(0, K)
    rho_new <- rep(0, L)
    Lambda_num <- matrix(0, K, L)
    Lambda_den <- matrix(0, K, L)
    
    idx <- 1
    for (a in 1:nrow(allZ)) {
      for (b in 1:nrow(allW)) {
        w <- probs[idx]; idx <- idx+1
        Z <- allZ[a,]; W <- allW[b,]
        
        for (i in 1:n) pi_new[Z[i]] <- pi_new[Z[i]] + w
        for (j in 1:m) rho_new[W[j]] <- rho_new[W[j]] + w
        for (i in 1:n) {
          for (j in 1:m) {
            Lambda_num[Z[i], W[j]] <- Lambda_num[Z[i], W[j]] + w*Y[i,j]
            Lambda_den[Z[i], W[j]] <- Lambda_den[Z[i], W[j]] + w
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    pi_new <- pi_new / n
    rho_new <- rho_new / m
    Lambda_new <- Lambda_num / Lambda_den
    
    # update
    pi <- pi_new; rho <- rho_new; Lambda <- Lambda_new
    
    loglik_trace <- c(loglik_trace, log_norm)
    
    # convergence
    if (iter>1 && abs(loglik_trace[iter]-loglik_trace[iter-1])<tol) break
  }
  
  list(pi=pi, rho=rho, Lambda=Lambda, loglik=loglik_trace)
}

# Helper: log-sum-exp
logsumexp <- function(x) {
  m <- max(x)
  m + log(sum(exp(x-m)))
}
```

```{r}
# -----------------------
# Example run
# -----------------------
set.seed(123)
K <- 2; L <- 2
pi <- rep(1/K, K)      # row cluster prior
rho <- rep(1/L, L)     # col cluster prior
Lambda <- matrix(runif(K*L, 0.2, 0.8), K, L)  # connection probs
toy <- simulate_LBM(n=2, m=2, K, L, pi, rho, Lambda)
fit <- EM_LBM(toy$Y, K=2, L=2, max_iter=20)

print(fit$Lambda)
plot(fit$loglik, type="b", main="Log-likelihood trace", ylab="loglik", xlab="iter")
```

## 2. Comparison ARI MCMC & VEM

```{r}
## Protocole pour test sur plusieurs LBM
K <- c(2,4,8)
L <- c(2,4,8)
N <- c(10, 50, 100, 200)
M <- c(10, 50, 100, 200)
params <- initialize_LBM_params(K = 2, L = 2, seed = 123)
ARI_params22 <- compare_MCMC_VEM(params,N,M)
params <- initialize_LBM_params(K = 2, L = 4, seed = 123)
ARI_params24 <- compare_MCMC_VEM(params,N,M)
params <- initialize_LBM_params(K = 2, L = 8, seed = 123)
ARI_params28 <- compare_MCMC_VEM(params,N,M)
params <- initialize_LBM_params(K = 4, L = 2, seed = 123)
ARI_params42 <- compare_MCMC_VEM(params,N,M)
params <- initialize_LBM_params(K = 4, L = 4, seed = 123)
ARI_params44 <- compare_MCMC_VEM(params,N,M)
params <- initialize_LBM_params(K = 4, L = 8, seed = 123)
ARI_params48 <- compare_MCMC_VEM(params,N,M)
params <- initialize_LBM_params(K = 8, L = 8, seed = 123)
ARI_params88 <- compare_MCMC_VEM(params,N,M)
```

```{r}
load(file="Rdata/d_pred_LBM.Rdata")

load(file="Rdata/d_herb_mat.Rdata")
load(file="Rdata/p_pred_mat.Rdata")
load(file="Rdata/d_pred_mat.Rdata")
```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2)) 
plot(p_herb_LBM, type  = 'meso', 
     dimLabels = list(row = 'plantes', col= 'herbivores'),
     plotOptions = list(edge.width = 1, vertex.size = c(3,3), title="p_herb"))
plot(d_herb_LBM, type  = 'meso', 
     dimLabels = list(row = 'plantes', col= 'herbivores'),
     plotOptions = list(edge.width = 1, vertex.size = c(3,3), title="d_herb"))
plot(p_pred_LBM, type  = 'meso', 
     dimLabels = list(row = 'proies', col= 'prédateurs'),
     plotOptions = list(edge.width = 1, vertex.size = c(3,3), title="p_pred"))
plot(d_pred_LBM, type  = 'meso', 
     dimLabels = list(row = 'proies', col= 'prédateurs'),
     plotOptions = list(edge.width = 1, vertex.size = c(3,3), title="d_pred"))
```

```{r}
res_VEM_p_pred <- VEM_LBM(p_pred_mat, p_pred_LBM$nbBlocks[1], p_pred_LBM$nbBlocks[2])
res_MCMC_p_pred <- gibbs_LBM(p_pred_mat, p_pred_LBM$nbBlocks[1], p_pred_LBM$nbBlocks[2], n_iter = 100)

# --- Compute ARI for both algorithms ---
i_VEM <- 1:res_VEM_p_pred$n_iter
i_MCMC <- 1:100

# --- VEM ---
ari_cols_VEM <- sapply(i_VEM, function(iter) {
  adjustedRandIndex(p_pred_LBM$memberships$prédateurs, apply(res_VEM_p_pred$xi[iter,,], 1, which.max))
})

ari_rows_VEM <- sapply(i_VEM, function(iter) {
  adjustedRandIndex(p_pred_LBM$memberships$proies, apply(res_VEM_p_pred$tau[iter,,], 1, which.max))
})

df_VEM <- data.frame(
  iteration = rep(i_VEM, 2),
  ARI = c(ari_rows_VEM, ari_cols_VEM),
  Type = factor(rep(c("Preys", "Predators"), each = length(i_VEM))),
  Method = "VEM"
)

# --- MCMC ---
ari_cols_MCMC <- sapply(i_MCMC, function(iter) {
  adjustedRandIndex(p_pred_LBM$memberships$prédateurs, res_MCMC_p_pred$W[iter, ])
})

ari_rows_MCMC <- sapply(i_MCMC, function(iter) {
  adjustedRandIndex(p_pred_LBM$memberships$proies, res_MCMC_p_pred$Z[iter, ])
})

df_MCMC <- data.frame(
  iteration = rep(i_MCMC, 2),
  ARI = c(ari_rows_MCMC, ari_cols_MCMC),
  Type = factor(rep(c("Preys", "Predators"), each = length(i_MCMC))),
  Method = "MCMC"
)

# --- Combine both ---
df_all <- rbind(df_VEM, df_MCMC)

# --- Création du label combiné ---
df_all$Label <- paste(df_all$Method, df_all$Type, sep = " - ")

# --- Définir les couleurs pour les 4 courbes ---
custom_colors <- c(
  "MCMC - Plants" = "#D95F02",     # orange
  "MCMC - Herbivores" = "#1B9E77",  # vert
  "VEM - Plants" = "#7570B3",      # violet
  "VEM - Herbivores" = "#E7298A",    # rose/rouge
  "MCMC - Preys" = "#D95F02",     # orange
  "MCMC - Predators" = "#1B9E77",  # vert
  "VEM - Preys" = "#7570B3",      # violet
  "VEM - Predators" = "#E7298A"    # rose/rouge
)

# --- Tracé combiné ---
p_all <- ggplot(df_all, aes(x = iteration, y = ARI, color = Label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.5) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 100, xmax = max(df_all$iteration), ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
           alpha = 0.1, fill = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Adjusted Rand Index Convergence",
    subtitle = "Predation Network - Pristine Island",
    x = "Iteration",
    y = "ARI",
    color = "Method - Clustering"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )

print(p_all)


```
